# Animation

Animators, bone attachments, IK effectors and sequence players.

## `animator` { #animator }

Skeletal animation for this entity's rigged meshes (and its children's): a state machine controller or one clip. Set parameters and triggers with animator_set or Wander set_param/trigger/play_animation.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `library` | string | Animation library (*.anim: skeleton + clips); empty = the one imported with the mesh |  |
| `controller` | string | State machine (*.animctl.json); empty = play `clip` |  |
| `clip` | string | Clip to play when there is no controller (empty = the first clip) |  |
| `speed` | number | Playback rate (0 pauses, 2 = double speed) | 0 .. 10 |
| `loop` | boolean | Loop the clip (without a controller) |  |
| `rootMotion` | boolean | Move the entity with the animation's root (hips) movement instead of in place |  |
| `preview` | string | Editor preview: rest = bind pose, pose = frame at `time`, play = animate live | `rest` `pose` `play` |
| `time` | number | Editor preview time (seconds into the default state / clip) | 0 .. 600 |
| `lookAt` | object \| string \| integer \| null | Entity the head and spine turn towards (look-at IK); empty = off — entity link: name ("Door"), "#id", {"id": 12} or null; read back as {"id", "name"} (follows renames; entity_refs lists links) |  |
| `lookAtWeight` | number | How strongly the head follows lookAt | 0 .. 1 |
| `lookAtLimit` | number | Maximum head/spine turn (degrees) | 0 .. 180 |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"animator": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.animator.library          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `attach` { #attach }

Keeps this entity on a bone of an animated character (weapon in a hand, hat on a head, lantern on a belt).

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `character` | object \| string \| integer \| null | Entity with the animator; empty = nearest ancestor that has one — entity link: name ("Door"), "#id", {"id": 12} or null; read back as {"id", "name"} (follows renames; entity_refs lists links) |  |
| `bone` | string | Bone name, e.g. RightHand or mixamorig:Head (animation_list shows them) |  |
| `offset` | number[3] | Position offset in the bone's space (meters) |  |
| `rotation` | number[3] | Rotation offset in the bone's space (Euler degrees) |  |
| `followScale` | boolean | Inherit the bone's scale (off keeps this entity's scale) |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"attach": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.attach.character          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `ik` { #ik }

Two-bone IK effector: the character's hand or foot (and elbow or knee) reaches this entity's position.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `character` | object \| string \| integer \| null | Entity with the animator; empty = nearest ancestor that has one — entity link: name ("Door"), "#id", {"id": 12} or null; read back as {"id", "name"} (follows renames; entity_refs lists links) |  |
| `bone` | string | End bone that reaches here: LeftHand, RightFoot... (animation_list lists bones) |  |
| `weight` | number | Blend between the animation (0) and the target (1) | 0 .. 1 |
| `pole` | number[3] | Bend direction in the character's space (e.g. [0,0,-1] knees forward); [0,0,0] keeps the animated bend |  |
| `matchRotation` | boolean | Also orient the end bone like this entity |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"ik": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.ik.character          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `sequencer` { #sequencer }

Plays a cinematic sequence (*.sequence.json): camera shots and cuts, keyed properties, events and animations. Build sequences with the sequence_* tools.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sequence` | string | Sequence asset (*.sequence.json) |  |
| `playOnStart` | boolean | Start playing when the simulation starts |  |
| `loop` | boolean | Loop at the end |  |
| `speed` | number | Playback rate | 0 .. 10 |
| `preview` | boolean | Editor: show the sequence frozen at `time` in the viewport |  |
| `time` | number | Editor scrub position (seconds) | 0 .. 3600 |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"sequencer": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.sequencer.sequence          -- read or write any field
    ```
